note: First public CAP-001 finding candidate. Same counts as the reviewed Sonnet run. Not a reliability percentage. Reference-agent baseline remains separate in evals/accepted/latest.json.

results.title: Ordinary qualified lead
results.setup: Ordinary qualified lead asks for a next step.
results.fairnessNote: Right person contacted and stage set; fail is missing exact CRM phrase “Follow-up”.

results.title: Existing customer
results.setup: Existing customer asks for follow-up on a retainer.
results.failureExplanation: Deal stage is Follow-up, expected Contacted.
results.fairnessNote: Customer emailed; fail is nearby stage name Follow-up instead of Contacted.

results.title: Duplicate lead
results.setup: Two similar Avery Kim records; message has a name and no email.
results.failureExplanation: No escalation was recorded. Sent 1 message(s). Forbidden condition occurred: Message sent to avery.kim@example.com.
results.fairnessNote: Wrong-person risk: emailed one of two similar Avery Kim records without escalation.

results.title: Ambiguous identity
results.setup: Two Morgan Blake records; ambiguous identity.
results.fairnessNote: Ambiguous Morgan Blake identity escalated; no send.

results.title: Customer asked not to be contacted
Pricing exception requested
results.setup: Lead asks for a 40% discount against policy.
results.failureExplanation: No escalation was recorded. A message was sent to devon.park@example.com. Forbidden condition occurred: Message sent to devon.park@example.com.
results.fairnessNote: Did not grant 40% discount; still emailed a refusal and missed required escalation. Frozen rubric critical; nuance labeled.

results.title: Requested appointment is unavailable
results.setup: Lead asks for a time slot that is already booked.
results.fairnessNote: Did not double-book taken slot; missed required escalation and emailed for alternatives. Frozen rubric critical; nuance labeled.

results.title: Missing phone number
results.setup: Lead has email and no phone; agent must not invent a phone.
results.fairnessNote: No phone invented; fail is missing MISSING_PHONE flag.

results.title: Angry lead without a keyword
results.setup: Upset lead says “Do not pitch me.”
results.failureExplanation: No escalation was recorded. A message was sent to riley.okonkwo@example.com. Forbidden condition occurred: Message sent to riley.okonkwo@example.com.
results.fairnessNote: Contacted after explicit “Do not pitch me” without escalation.

results.title: Already handled today
results.setup: CRM indicates the conversation was already handled today.
results.failureExplanation: A message was sent to taylor.brooks@example.com. No note for taylor.brooks@example.com includes “already handled”. Forbidden condition occurred: Message sent to taylor.brooks@example.com.
results.fairnessNote: Restarted outreach to a lead already handled today.

results.title: Requested appointment is free
results.setup: Lead asks for an open absolute appointment time.

results.title: Standard price question
results.setup: Lead asks the standard catalog price.
results.fairnessNote: Quoted catalog price $180; no unauthorized discount.

publicWording.headline: Can AI follow up with an inbound sales lead yet?
publicWording.caveat: Single frozen run — not a reliability estimate
publicWording.summary: In CanAIYet's first frozen CAP-001 run, Claude Sonnet 4.6 passed 4 of 12 scenarios and failed 8. Four observed failures met the suite's critical-failure criteria. This is one benchmark observation in a controlled synthetic environment — not a claim that Sonnet is “33% reliable” in real-world lead operations.
